notes.title: New Starters Orders 6 update (1.080).
notes.content:
Improved race visual features with Depth of Field, new Oculus (VR mode) HUD options and Ultra Wide (2560x1080) mode supported (for the race sequence).
Also a number of bug fixes and a couple of AI improvements.
